title: GitHub Can Build An App From One Prompt 🤯💻
description:
I discovered GitHub Spark, an AI-powered tool for creating web applications from natural-language prompts 🤖⚡

You can describe the app you want and Spark can generate a working experience that you can then iterate on, customize, and refine.

The interesting part is how quickly you can go from a rough idea to something you can actually interact with—without building every piece manually from the beginning.

If you're interested in AI app builders and vibe coding, GitHub Spark is definitely worth checking out.
